newsitem.title: USA: USDA 7-State and U.S. Cattle on Feed.
newsitem.headline: USDA 7-State and U.S. Cattle on Feed.

text.p: USDA U.S. cattle on feed. 7 states, 1,000-plus head feedlots (data in 1,000 head):
Note--On feed data include cattle placed on feed after beginning of quarter and marketed before the end of quarter.
USDA cattle on feed in the United States (1,000-plus head feedlots, data in 1,000 head):
Note--On feed data include cattle placed on feed after beginning of quarter and marketed before the end of quarter.

Analysts on average had expected the number of cattle on feed in the seven key states on February 1 at 103.9 percent of a year ago, and January placements at 107.5 percent of a year ago. January marketings were expected at 101.3 percent of a year ago. The seven major states are Arizona, California, Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska and Texas.
